# Majestik Magik

> Local-First Enterprise Software Infrastructure & Native Systems — high-impact performance upgrades, low-level web engineering, and critical codebase patches shipped within a 24–72 hour window.

Majestik Magik is a boutique software engineering operation run by Jamil Matheny, specializing in local-first architecture, edge-native deployments, AI-visible business infrastructure, and full-stack web systems. Services are delivered as fixed-price, on-demand engagements with no retainers and no bloat.

## What We Build

- Local-first web applications with offline sync, IndexedDB pipelines, and AWS Vault integration
- Edge-native Next.js deployments on Cloudflare Pages using V8 isolate scaling
- Core Web Vitals overhauls targeting 90+ Lighthouse scores with guaranteed delivery
- Shopify transactional email systems using custom Liquid templates and automated flow logic
- DNS, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC deliverability infrastructure for inbox reputation
- Technical GEO and AI visibility audits ensuring brand presence inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude
- Landing page redesigns with sub-second load times, elite animations, and full-stack API integrations
- Contact form, webhook, and API debugging with end-to-end verification

## Fixed-Price Services

- AI Code Extraction & Frontend Quick-Fix — $1,850
- Shopify Email & Notification Engine — $1,250
- DNS, SPF, DKIM & Deliverability Setup — $600
- Core Web Vitals & Speed Overhaul — $2,200
- Landing Page Redesign & Engineering — $4,500
- Technical GEO & AI Visibility Audit — $3,500
- Contact Form & Webhook Debugging — $450

## Portfolio Projects

- [Middleman Motors](https://middlemanmotors.com): Full-stack automotive dealership platform — 99 Lighthouse desktop, 12ms edge TTFB, 0ms TBT.
- [Pivot Quest Analytics](https://app.majestikmagik.dev/dashboard): Web performance and Core Web Vitals monitoring dashboard with LLM ingestion tracking.
- [CEARCO Chemicals](https://cearcochemicals.com): High-speed React storefront for a specialty chemical and pressure washer distribution brand.
- [Dr. Parris Gainer](https://parrisgainer.com): Custom WordPress deployment for mental health advocacy, author publishing, and community engagement.
- [Noel Customs](https://noelcustoms.shop): Shopify e-commerce platform for custom apparel and embroidered goods.
- [Jamil Cleaning Services](https://jamilcleaningapp.vercel.app): Booking and scheduling web app for commercial and residential cleaning services.

## Technical Stack

- Framework: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- Deployment: Cloudflare Pages via CNAME proxy, V8 isolate edge runtime
- Email: Cloudflare Email Routing with zero-overhead inbound pipelines
- SEO/GEO: Multi-layered JSON-LD @graph entity mesh with FAQPage, TechService, and Organization schema
- AI Visibility: llms.txt compliant, speakable schema, structured data targeting LLM crawlers
